_comment: skeuo wild_sculpt STAGE 4 — 'the SAME mask becomes the alpha'. Pure native nodes, NO API/credits. Take the blueprint (gray silhouette on pure white), threshold the white background to a mask, invert it so the body+wells are the alpha, and join → an RGBA cutout with transparent background. This is the deterministic alpha step done in ComfyUI; runs offline and is directly inspectable.
